verdict.rationale: Klaviyo is an email/SMS marketing platform, so automatic suppression of unsubscribes, bounces and spam complaints is an applicable axis. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions suppression lists, unsubscribe handling, bounce or complaint processing, or CAN-SPAM/GDPR compliance defaults. The pack covers only APIs, SDKs, the MCP server, AI features and pricing, so there is no evidence the capability is delivered.
